evidence_required: Approve or reject replacement of the current RM-X52/XM430 proposal and update GRIP-002/electrical/firmware/CAD together.
Acquire and metrologically register received XC330-T288-T and FPX330-S101; control frame STEP/drawing, mass and exact fastener stack.
Verify the four radial slots, screw head clearance, thread engagement, torque, locking, reuse and pinion seating on received parts.
Complete involute/rack tooth engineering, backlash/tolerance stack, print orientation, process capability, lubrication policy and wear life.
Release rack guide geometry, running clearance, debris tolerance, end stops and retained behavior under external jaw loads.
Select exact filament/resin and supplier; release drying, machine, nozzle, layer, wall/infill, anneal/finish, coupon and lot evidence.
Create and prove exact FR12-H104K-to-FPX330/base transform, fasteners, tolerance stack, cable clearance and structural load path.
Eliminate access to both travel slots, pinion/rack mesh, jaw sweep and fixed/moving pinch lines with probe-tested retained guarding.
Select exact pad, adhesive/retention and reference foam; measure installed usable opening, parallelism, compression, damage and wear.
Use a calibrated load cell to establish current, force, repeatability and thermal limits; stall figures receive zero acceptance credit.
Recalculate branch protection/conductors/connectors/inrush/thermal and prove cable route, bend radius, strain relief and flex life.
Prove commanded-open, sudden power loss and object-drop containment into a fixed receiver with accepted abort criteria.
Measure every received moving item and assembled mass/COM/inertia; reconcile without omission or double counting.
Execute fit, no-load, guarded low-energy, force, wear, fastener-retention and fault tests under approved work instructions.
Obtain signed mechanical, electrical and safety review of one frozen configuration before any release state changes.
